title: Turn matches into records
description: Named groups turn log lines and other text into records whose fields have stable names.

steps.description: LOG names date, level, and msg in one log line. groupdict() returns those captures as a dictionary.
ADDR makes its port group optional. groupdict can return None for an absent port or use the supplied default value.

steps.question: What does the port field hold for localhost without a port?
steps.answer: groupdict() gives port the value None, while groupdict(default="80") supplies 80 instead.

steps.description: finditer produces a match for each log line. The list comprehension converts them into a list of named records.
The named backreference requires the closing quote to equal the opening quote. The replacement function reads first and last by name.
TOKEN combines named alternatives for token classes. lastgroup identifies the alternative that matched, except the loop skips whitespace.
For each non-whitespace match, the program prints its named token class and matched text.
